beginner.stem: Which of these is a listed use of Lanthanum?
options: A gas to vent, not to use

options: A gas to vent, not to use

beginner.stem: In which year does this catalog place the discovery of Lanthanum?

beginner.stem: Who does this catalog credit for finding Lanthanum?

beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Lanthanum?
options: The other half of von Welsbach’s 1885 split of didymium was neodymium, the new twin, from the Greek neos didymos.
Friedrich Ernst Dorn noticed in 1900 that radium gave off a radioactive gas.
Charles Hatchett analyzed a mineral in the British Museum in 1801 and announced a new element, which he called columbium, for Columbia.
Carl Gustaf Mosander, a student of Berzelius, separated a new earth from cerium nitrate in 1839.
beginner.explanation: Carl Gustaf Mosander, a student of Berzelius, separated a new earth from cerium nitrate in 1839.

beginner.stem: How does the catalog describe the discovery of Lanthanum?
options: The rose-pink fraction of the same crystallization was neodymium.
Friedrich Ernst Dorn collected the gas that bled out of a radium preparation in 1900 and found that the gas itself was radioactive.
Charles Hatchett examined a heavy black mineral in the British Museum, sent from Connecticut and catalogued as an iron ore.
Carl Gustaf Mosander suspected that ceria was not a single earth.
beginner.explanation: Carl Gustaf Mosander suspected that ceria was not a single earth.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Lanthanum in this catalog?
options: The Rose Half of the Twin
A Gas That Escaped From Radium
beginner.explanation: Carl Gustaf Mosander, a student of Berzelius, separated cerium nitrate until a new earth appeared inside a salt everyone had trusted.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Lanthanum in this catalog?
options: The Rose Half of the Twin
A Gas That Escaped From Radium
beginner.explanation: Mosander named the earth from a Greek verb meaning to lie hidden, an honest label for an element that had been concealed in ceria.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Lanthanum in this catalog?
options: The Rose Half of the Twin
A Gas That Escaped From Radium
beginner.explanation: The lanthanides came apart through the nineteenth century by repeated crystallization, a slow method that made tiny chemical differences finally visible.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Lanthanum in this catalog?
options: The Rose Half of the Twin
A Gas That Escaped From Radium
beginner.explanation: Lanthanum oxide helps special optical glasses bend light, and the metal also rides along with cerium in the alloys of lighter flints.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Lanthanum in this catalog?
options: The Rose Half of the Twin
A Gas That Escaped From Radium
beginner.explanation: Pulling lanthanum out of cerium did not end the surprises, because material from that work still concealed the mixture later called didymium.
